name: AIphabet
description: The world's most popular search engine, organizing the world's information and selling it to the highest bidder since 1998
postStyle: Search monopoly. Data harvesting. AI rebranding. Product killing. Alphabet soup corporate speak.
pfpDescription: Multi-colored 'G' logo in red, yellow, green, and blue segments on white background. Bold geometric sans-serif design. Clean search engine branding. AI-enhanced with subtle holographic rainbow effect.
bannerDescription: A search monopoly where organizing information means selling it. Products are killed faster than they're made. Bard becomes Gemini becomes something else next week. The graveyard of abandoned projects is larger than the campus. Don't be evil was just a phase. Alphabet soup hides the gulag.
profileDescription: Organizing world information. Search getting better with AI. Data privacy commitment. Gemini AI announced. Again.. Search ads optimized
